typescript-backend.architecture: Modular monolith; domain boundaries, validated configuration, stable API/error contracts, tests for import direction; split services only with evidence.

typescript-frontend.architecture: Feature-oriented modules; separate state, views, API clients and reusable UI.

python-tooling.architecture: Package-first modules; CLI entrypoint separated from domain logic and I/O; use src layout or existing package root.

cpp-native.architecture: Separate public interfaces, implementation and platform adapters; deterministic CMake builds.

documentation.architecture: Documentation-as-code with audience and navigation; no source tree required.

static-website.architecture: Static assets and page components; avoid unnecessary backend or build tools.

javascript-tooling.architecture: Small modules; explicit entrypoints; pure logic separated from I/O.

game-recomp.architecture: Separate guest adapters, generated code, handwritten runtime, platform services, patches and UI; CSR is a reference, not a dependency.

reverse-engineering.architecture: Separate analysis notes, recovered interfaces, reproducible scripts and evidence; keep restricted binaries outside Git.

godot-game.architecture: Scenes and components by feature; separate resources, runtime systems and editor tooling; respect project.godot and existing paths.

ai-workflow.architecture: Provider-independent contracts; tools, adapters, policies and deterministic verification; isolate untrusted context.

knowledge-system.architecture: Separate ingestion, normalization, retrieval, indexing and storage boundaries; version schemas.

full-stack.architecture: Separate deployable apps and shared contracts; monorepo only where it improves coordination.

library.architecture: Stable public API, internal modules and examples; semantic versioning.

desktop.architecture: Separate presentation, domain logic, platform services and persistence.

mobile.architecture: Feature modules; separate UI, domain and data adapters.

unity-game.architecture: Respect Unity Assets, Packages and ProjectSettings; organize runtime by feature.

unreal-game.architecture: Respect Unreal Source, Content and Config; isolate plugins and modules.

infrastructure.architecture: Declarative infrastructure; separate reusable modules, environments and policies.
